main_body: prehistoric thatched roof building with wooden log walls
top_band: yellow-tan thatched roof slope from row 5 to row 55 (51 rows)
evidence: The building shows a large foreshortened thatched roof slope (rows 5-55) with layered horizontal tiers, overhanging a dark eave shadow (rows 56-57) and vertical log front walls (rows 56-78) with a recessed doorway.

style.evidence: The thatched roof features rich vertical grain and horizontal tiering across 5-6 value steps, matching the density and material-tinted outline approach of the Beodeul reference buildings. The wooden log walls and stone base also show good per-element shading.
